title: mariscus melanocarpus
intro: Mariscus melanocarpus, commonly known as Black Sedge, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Mariscus melanocarpus include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation.
